payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the restrictions of the restricted track in the BEA 2019 Shared Task on grammatical error correction.

claims.text: The restricted track does not use spell checkers or other NLP tools, relying solely on neural sequence models.
Insertions are restricted to three tokens: ',', '-', and ''s', with only one insertion allowed per sentence.
The training data for the restricted track includes 1.2M pairs of corrected and uncorrected sentences, with a focus on exploring purely neural models.
